source_title: DelDOT Oversize/Overweight Permit System — FAQ (2 Del. Admin. Code 2405)
verify_reasons: Superload definition, permit fees ($30 min / $60 superload / $10 per 8,000 lbs overweight), validity, signal-review and bridge-review rules read from the official DelDOT OSOW FAQ. The escort matrix (width over 13'/14'/15', height 15'/17'6", length 90'/100'-120'/120'+ with DSP) is cross-referenced from published summaries of the DelDOT Policy & Procedures Manual (2 Del. Admin. Code 2405) — confirm exact configuration with the DelDOT Hauling Permit Office (302-326-4589 / 302-739-4366).

superload_thresholds.note: DelDOT superload = 15' wide, 15' high, 120' long, or over 120,000 lbs gross. Superload permit minimum $60; subject to DelDOT Bridge Management review (automatic when any individual axle weight exceeds 28,000 lbs); review may take up to 14 days. Loads 15'+ high are routed to the DelDOT Signal Supervisor.

width.note: over 13' wide: 1 rear escort on multi-lane highways / 1 front escort on two-lane highways
at/over 15' wide (superload): 1 front + 1 rear + Delaware State Police (DSP)

height.note: at 15' high (superload): 1 front + 1 rear escort; over 15' routed to DelDOT Signal Supervisor
at 17'6" high: 1 front + 1 rear + Delaware State Police (DSP)

length.note: over 120' long: 1 front + 1 rear + Delaware State Police (DSP)

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip permit minimum = $30.00 ($60.00 for a superload). Overweight fee = $10.00 for every 8,000 lbs (or portion thereof) of weight over the vehicle's legal weight limit (DelDOT / 2 Del. Admin. Code 2405).
single_trip.note: Permit valid 5 days. Escort vehicles must carry roof-mounted amber warning lights.

annual.note: Annual/blanket hauling permits available for qualifying repetitive moves; fee via DelDOT OSOW system.

movement_restrictions: Permitted loads authorized to move sunrise to sunset, Monday through Sunday
Loads 15' or greater in height routed to the DelDOT Signal Supervisor for review/approval
Superloads and sub-superload heavy moves subject to DelDOT Bridge Management axle-weight analysis (automatic over 28,000 lbs per axle)
notes: Legal limits: width 8'6", height 13'6", gross 80,000 lbs; 53' semitrailer on the National Network. Permit thresholds per Chapter 45, Title 21, Delaware Code.
Superload/fee/validity from the official DelDOT OSOW FAQ; escort matrix from published summaries of the DelDOT Policy & Procedures Manual (2 Del. Admin. Code 2405).
